title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Claims Manual: Coverage Decisions on a Repair Claim
content:
## 1. Clauses

1.1 A claim can be authorized only while the plan status is active.

1.2 No claim is payable for a failure occurring before the plan's waiting period in days after the purchase date and before the plan's waiting period in miles beyond the odometer at purchase.

1.3 A claim opening may be decided only once.

1.4 A failure is covered when its component group is within the covered component groups for the plan, or, for an exclusionary plan, is not an excluded wear item, a cosmetic item, or a group switched off by the plan's hybrid and EV drive component, electronics or seals and gaskets coverage.

1.5 Where the plan requires prior authorization, a repair started before authorization is denied for no prior authorization; pre-existing conditions are denied where the plan excludes pre-existing conditions, and documented neglect of scheduled maintenance is denied for maintenance neglect.

These clauses apply to every Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan, each with its own component groups, exclusions and waiting period figures.

## 2. The claim and its records

A repair facility opens a claim on a repair order, recording the repair order number, the date, the odometer, the component group of the failed part, the kind of facility (the selling Kestrel dealer, another Kestrel dealer, or an ASE-certified independent facility) and the estimate. The decision on that opening is recorded as an authorization, with the amount authorized after the deductible and the deductible applied, or as a denial, with its reason. Every judgement below is made on the company's plan and claim records, correlated to the plan the claim was opened on.

## 3. Plan status (clause 1.1)

| Plan status at the decision | Authorization possible |
|---|---|
| Active | Not barred by this clause |
| Pending activation | No |
| Cancelled | No |
| Expired | No |
| Limit exhausted | No |

## 4. Waiting period (clause 1.2)

The waiting period has a day measure, counted in calendar days from the plan's purchase date, and a mileage measure, counted beyond the odometer reading at purchase. A failure that occurs before the day measure is reached and before the mileage measure is reached is not payable.

*Hypothetical case.* A plan with a waiting period of 30 days and 1000 miles was bought with a hypothetical odometer of 12000 miles. A failure on the tenth day after purchase at 12400 miles occurs before the thirtieth day and before 13000 miles, so no claim for it is payable.

## 5. One decision per claim opening (clause 1.3)

Once an authorization or a denial has been recorded against a claim opening, that opening has been decided: no second authorization and no second denial is made on it.

## 6. Is the failed component covered? (clause 1.4)

- **Stated component plan** (Kestrel Care Powertrain, Gold, Gold Plus): covered when the failed part's component group is one of the plan's covered groups; a stated component plan covers only its listed groups.
- **Exclusionary plan** (Kestrel Care Platinum, Platinum Plus, Platinum Elite): covered when the failure is not the plan's excluded wear item, not a cosmetic item, and not in a group the plan switches off among hybrid and EV drive components, electronics, and seals and gaskets.

*Hypothetical cases.* An air-conditioning failure on a stated component plan whose covered groups include air conditioning is covered; the same failure on a stated component plan whose groups are engine, transmission and drive axle only is not. A paint defect on an exclusionary plan that excludes cosmetic items is not covered.

## 7. Grounds of denial (clause 1.5)

| Situation shown on the claim | Plan setting | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Repair started before authorization | Prior authorization required | Denied for no prior authorization |
| Failure existed before the plan's purchase | Pre-existing conditions excluded | Denied |
| Documented neglect of scheduled maintenance | — | Denied for maintenance neglect |
